slides.headline: What does it mean?
slides.body: When a supplier changes from trading terms to requiring payment upfront, it can suddenly tighten your own cash flow. A flexible facility can absorb that shift without forcing an abrupt change to how you operate.

caption:
A supplier moving from trading terms to upfront payment can catch a business off guard, tightening cash flow with little notice — even when nothing about your own operations has changed.

A flexible facility can absorb that shift, keeping orders flowing normally while you assess whether it's worth negotiating, adapting, or looking elsewhere.
